title: Disable Cramfs Kernel Module
description: Check for the cramfs kernel module on the target host and, if found, unload it and add modprobe.d configuration to prevent future loading.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: The hostname or IP address of the managed host to SSH into.

parameters.name: module_name
parameters.description: Name of the kernel module to check and disable.

playbook_output.description: Whether the cramfs module directory was found and a list of the actions taken.

fields.name: module_found
fields.description: Indicates whether the cramfs module directory exists on the system.

fields.name: actions
fields.description: List of strings describing the actions that were performed (e.g. unloaded kernel module, added install configuration, added blacklist configuration).

steps.name: Find cramfs module directories
steps.function: Search for cramfs module directories under /lib/modules to determine if the module exists on the system.

steps.name: Module exists?
steps.function: Branch on whether any cramfs module directory was found.
steps.condition: At least one cramfs module directory was found.

steps.name: Check if module loaded
steps.function: Determine whether the cramfs kernel module is currently loaded by checking the output of lsmod.

steps.name: Module loaded?
steps.function: Decide if the cramfs module is currently loaded and therefore needs to be unloaded.
steps.condition: The cramfs module is currently loaded (reported by lsmod).

steps.name: Flag unload needed
steps.function: Set a fact indicating that an unload attempt is required.

steps.name: Unload module
steps.function: Attempt to unload the cramfs module using modprobe and rmmod, ignoring failures if the module is built-in or already absent.

steps.name: Add install configuration
steps.function: Ensure that an 'install cramfs /bin/false' line is present in the module’s configuration file under /etc/modprobe.d.

steps.name: Record install status
steps.function: Capture whether the install configuration line was actually added because it was missing.

steps.name: Add blacklist configuration
steps.function: Ensure that a 'blacklist cramfs' line is present in the module’s configuration file under /etc/modprobe.d.

steps.name: Record blacklist status
steps.function: Capture whether the blacklist configuration line was actually added because it was missing.

steps.name: Compile remediation results
steps.function: Assemble the final output facts: whether the module was found and a list of actions that were performed.

computations._actions: {{ (['unloaded kernel module'] if (_unload_needed | default(false)) else []) + (['added install configuration'] if (_install_changed | default(false)) else []) + (['added blacklist configuration'] if (_blacklist_changed | default(false)) else []) }}

steps.name: Summarize not-found case
steps.function: Set facts when the cramfs module directory was not found – no remediation is necessary.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the structured output with module_found and the list of actions taken.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Check module existence
phases.description: Determine whether the cramfs kernel module directory is present on the target system.

phases.name: Remediation
phases.description: If the module exists, check if it is loaded, then unload it and ensure the appropriate modprobe.d configuration is in place.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured final result to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
